facts.text: The hotel is a ski-in/ski-out property.
The hotel sits at the foot of Blackcomb Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Nestled at the foot of Blackcomb Mountain

facts.text: The slopeside pools include a heated lap pool, an indoor/outdoor heated leisure pool and four whirlpools.
facts.excerpt: an indoor/outdoor heated leisure pool provides fun for all ages. Or ease your tired muscles with a soak in our four rejuvenating whirlpools.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests get private check-in/out and an exclusive lounge with breakfast and canapes.
facts.excerpt: Private Check-in/out and exclusive lounge with breakfast / canapes

facts.text: The Fairmont Gold Penthouse is a loft-style suite with 25-foot floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a Juliette balcony.
facts.excerpt: Impressive Loft Style Suite w/ 25 Ft Floor to Ceiling windows leading to Juliette Balcony

facts.text: The hotel welcomes small pets for a daily fee, and pets are not allowed in the Fairmont Gold Penthouse Suites.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Chateau Whistler welcomes small pets for a rate of CAD $50 plus applicable taxes per day.

facts.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

facts.text: One-bedroom suites with a living room, double sofabed and fireplace are described as popular family accommodation.
facts.excerpt: Popular Family Accommodation boasting expansive view of Rainbow Mountain, Large living room area with double sofabed and fireplace, 2 bathrooms

facts.text: Deluxe Slopeside View rooms look onto Whistler Mountain and the slopes of Blackcomb Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the most popular views of Whistler Mountain and the Slopes of Blackcomb Mountain, a cozy sitting area

facts.text: Vida Spa is an in-house spa.
The hotel has a slopeside Health Club.
facts.excerpt: retreating to our slopeside Health Club

facts.text: The Wildflower serves a breakfast buffet.
The hotel's golf course is a Robert Trent Jones Jr. design.
facts.excerpt: this Robert Trent Jones Jr. masterpiece

facts.text: The hotel has an on-site mountain golf course.
